selector.title: What would you like to learn?
selector.description: Choose a topic to see the controls highlighted in order on the current screen.
selector.manualNotice: To read step-by-step instructions, open the user menu and select the user guide.

gettingStarted.title: First steps in KIKIORI
gettingStarted.description: Get a short orientation to the main screen areas and where to start.

createKnowledge.title: Create knowledge
createKnowledge.description: Learn the flow from knowledge creation through interview and question settings.

runInterview.title: Run an interview
runInterview.description: Create a record and learn the AI conversation, answer composer, and knowledge review flow.

reviewKnowledge.title: Edit and confirm knowledge
reviewKnowledge.description: Review and correct interview records, then confirm the content that needs action.

knowledgeSettings.title: Review knowledge settings
knowledgeSettings.description: Find the place to review or update question fields and interview settings.

adminAnalysis.title: Review admin analysis
adminAnalysis.description: Learn how to filter the admin dashboard and review totals, trends, and records needing attention.

navigation.title: Choose a workspace
navigation.description: Use the navigation on the left to choose the knowledge area, records, and other workspaces.

knowledgeList.title: View the knowledge list
knowledgeList.description: Choose a knowledge area from the list to open its interview or settings.

knowledgeItem.title: Choose a knowledge area
knowledgeItem.description: Select a knowledge name to open its interview workspace.

userMenu.title: Use the user menu
userMenu.description: Use the user area at the bottom to change language or open help and guides.

interviewStart.title: Find the interview entry point
interviewStart.description: Create a new record here or select an in-progress record to resume it.

interviewEntry.title: Create or resume a record
interviewEntry.description: Enter a title to start a new record, or select an in-progress row to continue.

interview.title: Run the interview
interview.description: Follow the conversation with AI, enter answers, and organize knowledge step by step.

knowledge.title: Review knowledge context
knowledge.description: Use the knowledge panel on the right to review the question list and interview results.

composer.title: Send an answer
composer.description: Enter an answer in the composer at the bottom and send it. You can also switch to a voice interview.

createKnowledge.title: Create knowledge
createKnowledge.description: Enter a name and purpose for a new knowledge area to begin creating it.

createKnowledgeForm.title: Enter creation details
createKnowledgeForm.description: Enter the name, purpose, description, and tags, then review and create the knowledge area.

knowledgeDetails.title: Review the knowledge details
knowledgeDetails.description: Review the name, description, purpose, and tags that form the foundation of the interview.

interviewSettings.title: Set interview options
interviewSettings.description: Choose the interview purpose, models, question design model, and optional prompt template.

questionSettings.title: Set question options
questionSettings.description: Review the fields AI will cover during the interview and edit the ones that need changes.

questionAdd.title: Add a question field
questionAdd.description: Use this control to add a field, then enter its name and description.

knowledgeSettings.title: Review knowledge settings
knowledgeSettings.description: Review the knowledge details, question fields, and interview execution settings here.

knowledgeEdit.title: Edit question fields
knowledgeEdit.description: Add or edit the fields that AI uses during the interview.

knowledgeReview.title: Review an item that needs confirmation
knowledgeReview.description: This item contains extracted or pending content. Read it and correct it when needed.

records.title: Review interview records
records.description: Check progress in the record list and open the record you need.

recordItem.title: Choose a record to review
recordItem.description: Check the title, owner, status, and updated time, then open the record.

recordDetail.title: Review the record content
recordDetail.description: Compare the conversation with the knowledge panel and review extracted or pending answers.

dashboard.title: Open the admin dashboard
dashboard.description: Administrators and knowledge managers can review the overall knowledge operation here.

dashboardFilters.title: Filter the analysis scope
dashboardFilters.description: Adjust the scope by date, knowledge, interview profile, and record status.

dashboardTabs.title: Switch analysis views
dashboardTabs.description: Use Analysis for operations and Learning support for learning status and generated analysis.

dashboardSummary.title: Review the summary metrics
dashboardSummary.description: Use the knowledge, record, pending-review, and priority counts to understand the overall state.

dashboardTrend.title: Review record trends
dashboardTrend.description: Compare created, submitted, and approved records to understand changes over time.

dashboardLearning.title: Review learning status
dashboardLearning.description: Check counts for confirmed, pending, and follow-up items.

dashboardAnalysis.title: Review learning analysis
dashboardAnalysis.description: Select a knowledge area, generate analysis, and review summaries, trends, and guidance.

dashboardReview.title: Open priority records
dashboardReview.description: Review high-priority records and the reasons they need attention, then open their details when needed.

knowledgeConfirm.title: Confirm the content
knowledgeConfirm.description: After reviewing and editing, save or approve the content to confirm it.

knowledgeCreated.title: Knowledge was created
knowledgeCreated.description: Continue with a short guide to reviewing the knowledge you just created.
